title: end mining
description: My first attempt at modding created an "end fragment" that is stackable up to 72. Future updates will make this item mineable in the end and able to be crafted with.
body: Since you can't mine anything in the End, I thought it would be cool to create a mod that lets you do it. This is my first attempt at a Minecraft mod for Hack Club's Hackcraft YSWS event, so this is currently pretty basic. My mod adds a new item (End Fragment) that you can get in Creative Mode. It is also stackable up to 72 items. The next version of this mod will make the End Fragment mineable from a custom block (still to be created/added) in the End and hopefully craft things with it.
